identification: Two old brass-bladed screwdrivers with turned fruitwood/timber handles and brass ferrules (non-sparking magazine/ordnance type). One has a long flat brass blade stamped with an asterisk/star, a broad arrow over 'WD', a 'J' (inspector) and a date that reads about 1898 (close-up is blurry). The other has a short, wide brass blade, no mark seen. British War Department issue, late 19th century.
